title: FairLLaVA: Fairness-Aware Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Vision-Language Assistants

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating equity-scaled natural language generation and clinical efficacy metrics (e.g., BLEU, RadGraph-F1, GREEN) across different racial groups, and computing counterfactual fairness gaps between clinically matched samples from different races.

Evaluating equity-scaled natural language generation and clinical efficacy metrics (e.g., BLEU, RadGraph-F1, GREEN) across different age groups, and computing counterfactual fairness gaps between clinically matched samples from different age brackets.

Evaluating equity-scaled natural language generation and clinical efficacy metrics (e.g., BLEU, RadGraph-F1, GREEN) across different gender groups, and computing counterfactual fairness gaps between clinically matched samples of different genders.
